BPM GUSD reserves examination - August 31, 2026; signed October 6, 2026

reserveReview.rationale: The August 31, 2026 BPM examination, signed October 6, reports reserve holdings as cash deposits at State Street and Western Alliance Bank. Net cash receivables/payables arising from timing and settlement reconcile gross deposits to issued and circulating GUSD; they are not separate reserve asset slices. The report establishes this dated asset-class composition, not the contractual maturity or demand terms of the bank accounts, the allocation between banks, or bridge escrow/receipt/in-flight accounting.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The examination discloses the complete reserve asset class and names both banks, but does not disclose the allocation between them.
